name: Rillwick
subtitle: Water and caffeine tracker
shortDescription: Fill a glass as you drink through the day. Log water, tea or coffee in one tap, see your week at a glance, and plan your last coffee. Works fully offline.
longDescription:
Rillwick is a calm little drink log. Tap a size, watch the glass rise, and get on with your day.

### Tap, Sip, Done
Quick-log buttons put your usual cup sizes one tap away. Made a mistake? Undo it from the confirmation, or edit any entry later. Choose millilitres or fluid ounces, and the cup sizes follow your region.

### A Goal That Fits Your Day
Enter your weight and activity and Rillwick suggests an everyday daily target. Mark a warm or active day and it nudges the figure up a little. Prefer your own number? Switch the suggestion off and set it yourself.

### The Caffeine Clock
Coffee, tea, soda and energy drinks add their usual caffeine. Rillwick shows when to have your last cup before bed, draws a rough curve of the next 24 hours, and lets you try "what if I have one now?" before you pour it. You can edit the milligrams for any drink.

### See How You Are Doing
Seven, thirty and ninety day charts, a streak, your best day and a short weekly note on patterns such as how much you drink before noon.

### Gentle Reminders, Only When You Want Them
Pick your hours and how often. Logging a drink pushes the next nudge back, and once you reach your goal the rest of the day stays quiet.

### Built to Stay Out of the Way
- Works completely offline, from the first launch
- No account, no sign-up
- Your log stays on your device, with CSV export when you want a copy
- Light and dark appearance, Dynamic Type, and a roomy layout on iPad
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Log a glass in Rillwick"
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
